reviewedRef.note: This branch only adds the quality-gate agent, CI workflow, and docs; it does not modify server/. All findings pre-exist on main.

commandsExecuted.notes: no server/ changes on this branch
skipped: no test script, no test files

findings.evidence: npm install exits 1 with ETARGET for drizzle-kit@^0.13.3; only 0.13.0 is published in that line.
findings.impact: Project cannot be installed, built, tested, or shipped through any CI pipeline.
findings.requiredCorrection: Pin drizzle-kit to an installable version compatible with drizzle-orm 0.28.x; verify npm install succeeds; commit the resulting lockfile.

findings.evidence: auth.ts queries/inserts users.email and users.password, but server/src/db/schema.ts's users table only has id, address, builderCode, createdAt.
findings.impact: register()/login() cannot function against the actual schema.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reconcile auth.ts with the wallet-signature model the README describes and the schema already supports, or add the missing columns if email+password auth is actually intended.

findings.location: import bcrypt from 'bcrypt'; import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
findings.evidence: Neither bcrypt nor jsonwebtoken (nor @types) are declared in server/package.json.
findings.impact: auth.ts cannot compile or run even if LA-QG-001/002 are fixed.
findings.requiredCorrection: Declare bcrypt/@types/bcrypt/jsonwebtoken/@types/jsonwebtoken if this model is kept, or remove the imports if auth.ts is rewritten.

findings.evidence: Hardcoded fallback secret used whenever JWT_SECRET is unset.
findings.impact: Deployments that omit JWT_SECRET silently accept tokens forgeable by anyone who reads the source.
findings.requiredCorrection: Fail fast at startup if JWT_SECRET is unset outside local dev.

findings.evidence: No lockfile present; new CI workflow fails closed on this.
findings.impact: Installs are not reproducible; CI cannot get past the install step.
findings.requiredCorrection: Commit server/package-lock.json once npm install succeeds.

findings.location: register/login never mounted; README describes signature-based auth
findings.evidence: grep for register/login/auth in server.ts returns no matches; README states auth is signature-based and private keys never reach the server.
findings.impact: No working authentication is reachable through the running server, contrary to documentation.
findings.requiredCorrection: Wire a corrected auth implementation into server.ts with tests, or remove the dead code until the documented model is implemented.

findings.evidence: No test files exist; no test script defined.
findings.impact: Signal-generation and risk logic (indicators.ts, technical-analysis.ts) has zero automated verification.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add a test runner and unit tests for indicators.ts and technical-analysis.ts at minimum.

findings.evidence: CORS enabled with no origin allowlist.
findings.impact: Cross-origin exposure once reachable outside local dev.
findings.requiredCorrection: Set an explicit origin allowlist before any non-local deployment.

findings.evidence: A single Client (not Pool) is created once at module load with no reconnect logic.
findings.impact: A dropped connection takes down all DB access until process restart.

findings.evidence: No lint or test script defined.
findings.impact: CI's lint/test steps currently no-op with a warning.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add ESLint and a test runner with matching scripts.

findings.evidence: Doc comment states older rows are not automatically purged; no cleanup job exists.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add a scheduled cleanup enforcing HISTORY_LIMIT per symbol.

findings.impact: Duplicate user rows per wallet address are not prevented at the DB level.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add a unique index once the auth model is finalized.

findings.evidence: Plain uuid columns with no FK reference.
findings.impact: Referential integrity relies entirely on application code.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add FK constraints once the write paths are implemented and tested.

findings.evidence: Several dependency pins are dated relative to current majors.
findings.impact: Widens future upgrade effort; delays security patches.
findings.requiredCorrection: Schedule a routine dependency refresh once npm audit can run.
